versions.changelog:
Initial release of issuefinder-tool – a comprehensive vehicle log analysis and download tool.

- Added cloud log downloading, local log analysis, and automatic fault analysis features.
- Supports multiple log formats, smart log type detection, and archives extraction (zip, tar.gz, 7z).
- Integrated recommended wrapper script (iflog) for automated path management and convenient log grouping by date.
- Documented usage for cloud, local, fault analysis, and direct download modes.
- Included detailed parameter descriptions, log type lists, time format handling, and troubleshooting guidance.
